messages:
maria.nieves: Customer (gov health org) just asked for per-key KMS usage logs + RBAC change events tied to SAML ids. They want event-level proofs for HIPAA + FedRAMP pre-audit. Thoughts?

alex.chung: We emit basic audit for auth, model.invoke, resource.create/delete, policy.update — but we don't currently surface KMS-level ops (Encrypt/Decrypt/Sign) in the same event model. Need schema bump.

jin.wu: Suggest adding explicit fields: actor_id, actor_type, actor_role, action, resource_id, resource_type, request_id, outcome, request_ts, key_id, key_alias, key_version, kms_op, correlation_id. Keep payloads minimal for PHI.

samir.patel: Important: for HIPAA customers do NOT log prompt texts or PHI. Use prompt_hash + prompt_entropy metadata. Also flag where we redact.

alex.chung: Example event (sketch):
```json
{
  "event_type": "kms_operation",
  "request_id": "req_0a1b2c",
  "request_ts": "2026-06-15T14:23:10Z",
  "actor_id": "saml|john.doe@example.com",
  "actor_role": "platform-admin",
  "action": "Decrypt",
  "resource_type": "model.cache",
  "resource_id": "cache-493",
  "key_id": "arn:aws:kms:...:key/abcd",
  "key_alias": "projects/prod/keys/llm-signing",
  "key_version": "v3",
  "kms_op": "decrypt",
  "outcome": "success",
  "event_signature": "base64sig..."
}
```

security-bot: audit-schema-bump: flagged proposed schema -> v2.2, owners alex.chung, jin.wu, samir.patel. :eyes:

liz.legal: Heads-up: if we accept contractual obligations to deliver raw KMS access logs or customer-signed proofs we need to update SLA language, breach notification timelines, and indemnity. FedRAMP customers often want exportable, correlate-able logs across our stack.

kevin.ops: For Dedicated/Private we can offer raw event stream (Kinesis/S3) encrypted with customer-managed KMS. Hosted customers get signed digests + signed manifests. Need to document differences.

maria.nieves: Customers are also asking: how do they validate events? They want event-level HMAC or signature they can verify later. Can our write path sign each event?

alex.chung: Two options: 1) service signs with our HSM/KMS and publish public verification key; 2) for private, allow signing with customer KMS (customer owns key). Need rotation and verification docs. Performance impact needs assessment.

jin.wu: Also add RBAC change events: role.assign, role.revoke, role.update with fields prev_role, new_role, admin_id, change_ts. These are critical for FedRAMP audit trails.

samir.patel: For vuln triage: if a key compromise suspected, we need explicit compromise_notice events + key_rotation events and re-encrypt_task markers so we can show customers remediation steps. Add "compromise_suspected": boolean and "mitigation_action": ["rotated","re-encrypted","revoked"].

kevin.ops: Ops note: richer events = bigger logs and higher egress. We'll need sampling rules, compression, and clear pricing/limits. Also ensure backward compatibility: add new optional fields and a schema version header.

maria.nieves: Next steps: alex/jin open RFC with schema diff + sample events and migration notes; samir draft HIPAA redaction guidance; kevin to list export options & cost implications; liz to draft contract clause options (attestation vs guaranteed export).

liz.legal: I'll draft contract language. Preference: attestation + signed manifests by default; raw export as a paid add-on.

alex.chung: I'll open the RFC today and attach example events + validation tests (HMAC verification CLI).

maria.nieves: Thanks all. Can one of you put a short slide for the next compliance sync (what we can commit to vs paid add-on)?

kevin.ops: I'll do a 2-slide summary.

security-bot: thread-closed-for-now: RFC opened -> PR #4021 (alex.chung).
